js: window.__sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.__ta = () => document.querySelector('.composer textarea'); window.__t = (v) => { const ta = window.__ta(); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(ta, v); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ta.focus(); }; window.__key = (key, extra) => { const el = document.activeElement || document.body; el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', Object.assign({key, bubbles:true, cancelable:true}, extra||{}))); }; window.__btn = (re) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => re.test((b.textContent||'').trim() || b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')); const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); return 'onboarded=' + s.settings.onboarded + ' demo=' + s.env.demo + ' accounts=' + s.accounts.map(a => a.name).join(',') + ' | page text: ' + document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0, 700)

const b = window.__btn(/^Continue/); if (!b) return 'no Continue button; disabled? text=' + document.body.innerText.slice(0,200); const dis = b.disabled; b.click(); await window.__sleep(900); return 'continue clicked (was disabled=' + dis + ') | text: ' + document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0, 600)
const b = window.__btn(/^Continue/); if (!b) return 'no Continue'; b.click(); await window.__sleep(900); return 'text: ' + document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0, 700)

const b = window.__btn(/^Start using Ensemble/); if (!b) return 'no Start button'; b.click(); await window.__sleep(1400); const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const ta = window.__ta(); return 'chatId=' + s.chatId + ' view=' + s.view + ' | textarea focused=' + (document.activeElement === ta) + ' placeholder=' + (ta && ta.placeholder) + ' | text: ' + document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0, 900)

window.__t('Add a pricing page with a checkout flow, and a hero image for it.'); await window.__sleep(200); window.__key('Enter'); await window.__sleep(700); const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); return 'sent; chatId=' + s.chatId + ' title=' + (s.chats.find(c=>c.id===s.chatId)||{}).title + ' | textarea now [' + window.__ta().value + ']'

const sc = document.querySelector('[data-view-scope]')?.parentElement; const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-label]')].map(e => e.getAttribute('aria-label')).filter(l => /copy|edit|retry|regenerate|resend|like|good|bad/i.test(l)); return 'transcript scrollH=' + (sc && sc.scrollHeight) + ' clientH=' + (sc && sc.clientHeight) + ' | copy/edit/retry-like aria-labels in page: [' + labels.join(',') + '] | stop button: ' + !!document.querySelector('.composer button[aria-label=Stop]') + ' | send label: ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('.composer button')].pop().getAttribute('aria-label')

const sc = document.querySelector('[data-view-scope]').parentElement; const before = sc.scrollTop; const h0 = sc.scrollHeight; sc.scrollTop = Math.max(0, sc.scrollTop - 260); await window.__sleep(150); const after = sc.scrollTop; await window.__sleep(2800); const jump = !!document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Jump to latest"]'); return 'scrolled up: ' + before + ' -> ' + after + ', 2.8s later scrollTop=' + sc.scrollTop + ' scrollH ' + h0 + ' -> ' + sc.scrollHeight + ' | jump button shown=' + jump + ' | (no unread/new-message count on it)'

const b = document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Jump to latest"]'); if (b) b.click(); await window.__sleep(900); const sc = document.querySelector('[data-view-scope]').parentElement; return 'jump clicked=' + !!b + ' distance from bottom=' + (sc.scrollHeight - sc.scrollTop - sc.clientHeight)

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const busy = Object.values(s.agents).filter(a => a.phase !== 'idle').length; const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || b.textContent || '').trim()).filter(t => t && /copy|edit|retry|regenerate|resend|check|undo|share/i.test(t)); return 'still busy agents=' + busy + ' | action-ish buttons: [' + labels.slice(0, 12).join(' | ') + ']'

const ta = window.__ta(); ta.focus(); window.__t(''); window.__key('ArrowUp'); await window.__sleep(300); const v = ta.value; return 'ArrowUp in empty composer -> textarea value [' + v + '] (empty = no edit-last-message)'

document.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'f', code:'KeyF', ctrlKey:true, bubbles:true, cancelable:true})); await window.__sleep(400); const finds = document.querySelectorAll('input[placeholder*="ind"]').length; return 'Ctrl+F in chat -> find inputs=' + finds + ' (0 = no in-chat find)'
window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'k', code:'KeyK', ctrlKey:true, bubbles:true, cancelable:true})); await window.__sleep(600); return 'palette open'

const inp = document.querySelector('[cmdk-input]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(inp, 'pricing'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await window.__sleep(900); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('[cmdk-item]')].map(i => i.textContent.trim().slice(0, 60)); return 'palette results for pricing: ' + items.join(' || ')

window.__key('Escape'); await window.__sleep(500); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'/', code:'Slash', ctrlKey:true, bubbles:true, cancelable:true})); await window.__sleep(600); return 'shortcuts dialog: ' + document.body.innerText.replace(/\s+/g,' ').match(/Keyboard shortcuts.{0,900}/)?.[0]

window.__key('Escape'); await window.__sleep(400); window.__ensemble.getState().setModal(null); window.__ensemble.getState().newChat(); await window.__sleep(800); window.__t('Draft I did not send'); await window.__sleep(300); return 'new chat draft typed'

const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); const first = s.chats[0]; await s.openChat(first.id); await window.__sleep(900); const back = window.__ta().value; await s.newChat(); await window.__sleep(600); return 'went to chat and back; the draft in the new-chat box is [' + window.__ta().value + '] (kept in memory only); chats in sidebar=' + s.chats.length
window.__ensemble.getState().setModal(null); await window.__sleep(300); const s = window.__ensemble.getState(); await s.openChat(s.chats[0].id); await window.__sleep(900); return 'back in first chat'
return 'narrow window; sidebar visible=' + !!document.querySelector('aside, nav') + ' innerW=' + innerWidth
